Method of Attack: Ask users to provide fingerprint to access app features but instead pop up subscription screen that automatically charges saved credit card for $99 to $119 USD
Use of fake reviews to appear legitimate and beneficial
Automatic charging via Touch ID without explicit user consent
Discoverer: ESET mobile app security researcher Lukas Stefanko
Impacted Systems: iPhone X (partially protected with Double Click to Pay)
Older iPhones with Touch ID enabled
Attack Vector: Malicious iOS fitness apps requesting fingerprint authentication
